svg.aria-label: A single sheet labelled the code, the final draft, sits in front of a stack of sheets fanned out behind it: the ticket, the commit, the PR description, the review thread, the person who argued against it, and the person who overruled them. A note under the stack: the why lives here.
svg.text: THE CODE IS THE FINAL DRAFT
the reasoning is in the history
git blame, then the PR it points to: the closest thing to asking the original author.
